cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A runs a meeting while displaying the cost of B lateness and adapting the display so a small apology can end the disruption.
confusable: Unlike simply recording lateness, A must offer removal for an apology; managerial confidence must depend on accommodating B practical needs.
comparison: Public meeting display and private apology option differ from a domestic sock being moved around dinner.
seedUse: Use D27-b documented time inconvenience and S02-a reclaiming a changed decision; move from bus receipts to a meeting display.
